Sous Sanho, au fond de Bada

description:
San-Ho has been living with his affectionate but somewhat strange lover, Bada-hyung, for two years. Every day, he practices his killer lines♡ and devises sloppy strategies to have sex with him, but for some reason, he never gives in and just touches him.

 *"If it's come to this—I have no choice but to eat you."* 

With a heavy heart, San-Ho sneaks into Bada's secret study and discovers a glowing book among the crowded bookshelves. The moment he opens the book, he loses consciousness and opens his eyes to find an unfamiliar forest landscape, a cat, and Bada-hyung with long hair?! With the help of a man who introduces himself as "Mare" and his familiar, "Pupa," San-Ho somehow manages to draw a magic circle, but instead of the dimension travel he's been hoping for, he ends up summoning something dangerous and sticky(?)...

 *"If you don't do something right now, I think I'm going to go crazy..." 

"No, no. I haven't even managed to do it with Bada-hyung yet..."*

I, Lee San-Ho, will I be able to safely return to my original world and be held in the arms of my Hyung Bada?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
